name: Dumbbell Lying Reverse Fly
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench with feet braced and dumbbells hanging beneath your shoulders.
Hold the handles with palms facing each other and set a slight bend in both elbows.
Sweep both arms out to the sides until your upper arms align with your torso.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the dumbbells smoothly back below your chest.
tips: Keep your chest resting on the bench without lifting your torso to swing the weights.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and avoid bending your elbows into a row.
